sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM 
    races AS T1
JOIN 
    circuits AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId
WHERE 
    T1.name = 'European Grand Prix'
